title: Beatification of Venerable Fulton J. Sheen
summary: The Church will beatify Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen at a Mass in St. Louis, recognizing his heroic Christian life and permitting him to be honored publicly as Blessed Fulton J. Sheen.

notice.title: Today is the Beatification of Archbishop Fulton Sheen
notice.body: The Church will declare the renowned American preacher and missionary Blessed Fulton J. Sheen today in St. Louis. Read about beatification, his life, his work in radio and television, and his service to the worldwide missions.
